recommendedTextbook.title: Comprehensive Economics for Senior Secondary Schools
recommendedTextbook.author: J.U. Anyaele
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education & NERDC

topics.topic: Theory of Demand and Elasticity of Demand
subtopics: Law of demand, demand schedule, and individual vs market demand curve
Factors determining demand and shifts in demand curve
Price, income and cross elasticity of demand formulas and calculations
objectives: State the first law of demand with ceteris paribus clause
Distinguish change in quantity demanded from shift in demand
Calculate price elasticity of demand coefficient (Ed)

topics.topic: Theory of Supply and Elasticity of Supply
subtopics: Law of supply, supply schedule, and upward-sloping supply curve
Determinants of supply: Cost of production, weather, technology
Price elasticity of supply: Elastic, inelastic, unitary, perfectly elastic
objectives: Plot supply curves from hypothetical market schedules
Analyze causes of supply contractions and expansions
Calculate numerical coefficient of price elasticity of supply

subtopics: Interaction of demand and supply at equilibrium price and quantity
Effects of shifts in demand and supply on equilibrium
Government price controls: Maximum price (price ceiling) and minimum price (price floor)
objectives: Calculate equilibrium price from demand and supply equations (Qd = Qs)
Explain economic consequences of fuel or rent price ceilings
Analyze minimum wage legislation as a price floor in Nigeria

subtopics: Short-run and long-run costs: Fixed cost (FC), variable cost (VC), total cost (TC)
Total revenue (TR), average revenue (AR), and marginal revenue (MR)
objectives: Plot typical U-shaped short-run average cost curves
Explain profit maximization condition where MC = MR
Calculate marginal cost from successive total cost figures
